description: Look up a Polygon PoS transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in POL, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use polygon_receipt, for emitted events polygon_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x23e86c30c46638b2e9798692fe89327a66aa8569a5d4a566125f655aeb8f80c7. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: polygon_tx
title: Polygon PoS transaction
